description: This file defines the authentication service for the application, specifically handling JWT token generation and validation within the backend. It includes an interface ITokenService and its implementation InMemoryTokenService, which generates tokens using a symmetric security key and provides validation parameters.

classes.name: ITokenService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for issuing and validating JWT tokens, including properties for issuer and audience.

classes.name: InMemoryTokenService
classes.description: Concrete implementation of ITokenService that generates JWTs with an in-memory symmetric key and provides validation parameters.

methods.name: IssueToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a given username, embedding claims and signing with a symmetric key.

methods.name: GetValidationParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters used to validate incoming JWT tokens, including issuer, audience, and signing key details.
